miro._comment_board: boardQuoteCount_* is a verbatim lift of desktop.connectAgent.quotes_*, not a translation — same shape, already reviewed. It gets its own key because a reword for the agent-access surface must not silently change a board a researcher has already sent. boardTitle names the artefact, so it composes this locale's own research word (header.researchReport) with its own board noun (above). clipLink is the noun from export.clips.*.

discussion._comment_guideHowTo: “Discussion guide” is the folder name the code looks for (bristlenose/discussion/guide.py). Keep it in English in every translation, or a researcher following the sentence makes a folder that is never read.
